description: A nursing supervisor must assign the hospital's overnight rapid-response primary clinician from three listed hospitalists and finalize the coverage roles and pager-check plan before the evening shift begins.

shared_context.S1: The hospital needs one rapid-response primary clinician for tonight's 19:00-07:00 shift.
shared_context.S2: Dr. Lin, Dr. Shah, and Dr. Ortiz are the three hospitalists listed on the preliminary overnight coverage roster.
shared_context.S3: Hospital policy requires the rapid-response primary clinician to be physically on campus for the full shift and current on the hospital's emergency-airway credential.
shared_context.S4: Marisol makes the binding overnight coverage assignment and records any role changes in the staffing system.
shared_context.S5: As part of the routine evening roster check, Marisol asks each listed hospitalist to state current duty or credential restrictions, then confirms the assigned clinician's pager before the shift starts.

PF1.text: Dr. Lin is already scheduled for a 19:00-07:00 ICU attending shift tonight and must remain assigned to the ICU rather than serve as rapid-response primary; the ICU schedule is finalized but has not been copied into the hospital-wide roster.

PF2.text: Dr. Shah's emergency-airway credential expired yesterday and the renewal becomes active tomorrow at 08:00, so Dr. Shah cannot serve as tonight's rapid-response primary; the credentialing system has not yet synchronized with the staffing roster.

PF3.text: Dr. Ortiz's emergency-airway credential is active, and Dr. Ortiz has confirmed an on-campus call-room arrival by 18:30 for the full overnight shift; the pager assigned to Dr. Ortiz must be tested at exactly 18:45.

acceptance_conditions: Dr. Ortiz must be assigned as the overnight rapid-response primary.
Dr. Lin must remain assigned to the ICU shift rather than rapid response.
Dr. Shah must be excluded from tonight's rapid-response coverage because the credential is not active.
Dr. Ortiz's pager must be tested at exactly 18:45.
The staffing system must contain an on-campus coverage commitment for Dr. Ortiz.
The assignment must cite the credential and availability facts stated by the hospitalists.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'on_campus_coverage' and c['target'] == 'Dr. Ortiz' and c['detail'] == '19:00-07:00' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Dr. Lin's existing 19:00-07:00 ICU assignment changes Lin's recorded role from a possible rapid-response assignment to exactly 'ICU attending.'
Dr. Shah's credential expiration changes Shah's overnight role from a possible rapid-response assignment to exactly 'not rapid-response eligible.'
Dr. Ortiz's active credential and confirmed 19:00-07:00 campus availability make Ortiz the qualifying primary and set the pager test to exactly 18:45 with an on-campus coverage commitment.
